research: Builds on this course's own Chapter 1 lessons on Approval Processes (Lesson 2) and Multi-Step and Parallel Approvals (Lesson 3).
note: Case-study lesson built around a clearly labeled fictional company (Harborline Industrial Supply) and an invented but realistic approval-process scenario. No real company, org, or data is represented. Consistent with this catalog's documented non-visual exception (scripts/course-build/SCREENSHOTS.md): a case-study walkthrough has no single real UI screen that represents it, so slides use steps/code cards instead of screenshots.
